TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 (UNKNOWN — not printed in the document)
cleanIntro: The GX4 is the one Taurus micro-compact whose field strip needs a tool: its takedown is a slotted pin on the RIGHT side of the frame that a flat head screwdriver turns a quarter turn counterclockwise. Everything after that is familiar - trigger press, slide forward, spring assembly, barrel - but the pin is what catches owners coming from a G3 or a TH. Taurus asks for a clean every 200 rounds and publishes nothing past the magazine strip.

steps.title: Confirm it is a GX4, and find the takedown pin before you start
steps.action: The GX4 is the 9mm Luger micro-compact: 3.06-inch barrel, 6.05 inches overall, 4.30 high, one inch wide, 18.5 ounces with an empty magazine, 11+1 rounds, single action only. Look at the RIGHT side of the frame above the trigger for a slotted takedown pin - that is the control this strip turns on.
steps.prose: A one-inch-wide 11+1 gun is small enough that Taurus's own warning about small handguns applies squarely: it is easy to sweep your support hand racking a 3-inch slide. Establishing the pin's location now also stops you hunting the left side of the frame for a disassembly latch that the GX4 does not have.
steps.aside: The GX4's listed safety devices are a firing pin block, a trigger safety and a visual loaded chamber indicator - there is no manual safety lever on this pistol, so nothing external can be put 'on' before you handle it.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Specifications, printed p.13 (PDF p.7)

steps.title: A GX4 does not come apart like the Taurus pistols it resembles
steps.action: Check that the pistol in your hand has the slotted takedown pin on the right of the frame before going further. Taurus warns that similar-looking firearms differ in the location and function of their controls, and the GX4's screwdriver-turned pin is the clearest case in their own line-up.
steps.prose: Its nearest siblings all use a lever: the G3, the G3c and the TH series take a disassembly latch pulled down on the LEFT side with the slide eased back an eighth of an inch. If you apply that here you will find nothing to pull, and if you apply the GX4's quarter turn to those you will find nothing to turn.
steps.quote:
FIREARMS ARE NOT ALL ALIKE
Many makes and models of firearms might LOOK nearly the same. However, they differ widely in design, operation, and in the location and function of various controls.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Ammunition, printed p.19 (PDF p.10)

steps.title: Magazine out, chamber cleared, then look and feel
steps.action: Keep your finger off the trigger and on the indexing pad, point the muzzle somewhere safe, press the magazine release and strip the magazine out. Clear the chamber, then look into and feel both the chamber and the magazine well.
steps.prose: The GX4's visual loaded chamber indicator sits on the slide and is a prompt, not a verdict - it tells you a case is present, it cannot tell you a case is absent when it is dirty. On a grip this short there is very little magazine well to feel into, so take the extra second rather than assuming.
steps.quote: 1. Before disassembly, always (1) keep your finger off the trigger and on the Indexing pad/(RMP), (2) point the muzzle in a safe direction, (3) remove the magazine by pressing the magazine release button, (4) Clear the chamber and make sure it is empty, and (5) look and feel the magazine well and chamber to confirm the pistol is empty. An empty firearm cannot fire.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Disassembly, printed p.24 (PDF p.13)
steps.warn: After removing the magazine, always check the chamber and make sure it is empty.

steps.title: No magazine disconnect on the GX4
steps.action: The magazine being out of the gun does not disarm it. Taurus states these pistols have no magazine disconnect and are capable of firing with the magazine removed, and the strip requires a deliberate trigger press two steps from now.
steps.prose: The GX4 has no manual safety, so there is no lever to fall back on either - the chamber check is the entire safety system for the next few minutes. A carry gun brought straight to the bench with its magazine dropped is exactly the pistol this warning is written for.
steps.quote: These Taurus pistols do not have a magazine disconnect (safety). They are capable of firing with the magazine removed.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Operating Instructions, printed p.21 (PDF p.12)

steps.title: Quarter turn counterclockwise on the takedown pin
steps.action: Find the takedown pin on the right side of the pistol and put a flat head screwdriver in its slot. Rotate it a quarter turn counterclockwise to unlock the slide from the grip - a quarter turn and no more; the pin does not come out of the frame.
steps.prose: It should turn with light, even pressure and stop crisply. If it fights you, the slide is not sitting fully forward at rest - ease it home and try again rather than levering harder, because the slot is shallow and a slipping screwdriver marks the frame. Use a blade that actually fills the slot.
steps.quote: 2. On the right side of the pistol is the take down pin (see page 12), using a flat head screwdriver, rotate the take down pin 1/4 turn counterclockwise to unlock the slide from the grip.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Disassembly, printed p.24 (PDF p.13)

steps.title: Trigger press, then push the slide forward off the grip
steps.action: With the muzzle in a safe direction and the chamber already confirmed empty, pull the trigger, then push the slide forward and away from the grip to separate the two.
steps.prose: The GX4 is single action only, so the striker is pre-cocked whenever the slide has cycled and the sear will not release the slide until the trigger drops it. Forward is the direction - the slide leaves off the front of the rails, it does not lift off the back.
steps.quote:
While pointing the pistol in a safe direction, pull the trigger and
push the slide forward away from the grip
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Disassembly, printed p.24 (PDF p.13)

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out from under the barrel
steps.action: Invert the slide and lift the recoil spring assembly out of its seat on the bottom of the barrel, controlling it with a cupped hand as the tension breaks.
steps.prose: A micro-compact runs a stiff spring over a very short stroke to hold a 9mm slide shut, so the GX4's assembly is one of the livelier ones on a bench for its size. It is captive - never separate the guide from the spring - and it goes back in only one way round.
steps.quote: 4. Release the recoil spring assembly from its position on the bottom of the barrel.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Disassembly, printed p.25 (PDF p.13)
steps.warn: Take care to prevent the forcible ejection of the recoil spring assembly as the spring is compressed.

steps.title: Barrel forward and up
steps.action: Move the barrel forward inside the slide until the lug clears, then lift it up and out. Frame, slide, barrel and recoil spring assembly - four pieces, and that is the strip.
steps.prose: The GX4's barrel carries a black DLC coating over stainless; it is hard, but it is a coating, so keep steel brushes to the bore and use a cloth on the outside. Check the bore against a light while it is in your hand.
steps.quote: 5. Remove the barrel from the slide by pulling it to the front and up.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Disassembly, printed p.25 (PDF p.13)

steps.title: If yours is a GX4 T.O.R.O., the plate story is model-specific
steps.action: Look at the top of the slide. A GX4 T.O.R.O. carries a factory-installed slide cover over an optic cut; a standard GX4 does not. If an optic is fitted, note that Taurus says additional positioning pins are only necessary for some models and that a Trijicon red dot needs an adapter plate that is sold separately - so what is under your optic is not the same as what is under the next GX4's.
steps.prose: That matters at cleaning time because it decides whether you are looking at pins, a plate, or bare slide when an optic comes off - and it decides the screw length. Taurus specifies M4x0.7 screws with a minimum of four threads of engagement, Loctite 242 and 8.2 in-lbs, cured 24 hours before firing. None of that is a wipe-down task; leave a mounted optic alone.
steps.caution: T.O.R.O. models only. A standard GX4 slide has no cover, no plate and nothing on top to unscrew.
steps.quote: Place desired red dot sight on top of the slide. Additional positioning pins are only necessary for some models. If using the Trijicon Red Dot, you will need an adapter plate (see page 31).
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — T.O.R.O. Configuration - Install Instructions, printed p.29 (PDF p.15)

steps.title: Every 200 rounds, and check the screws and pins while you are there
steps.action: Clean and lubricate at least every 200 rounds, and check for loose screws or pins at the same time - tighten screws and press pins back in as needed. Then bore and chamber with a brass brush and solvent, a dry patch through, a non-abrasive wipe of slide and rails, and oil on the rails and lockup points.
steps.prose: On the GX4 the screws-and-pins line has a specific target: the takedown pin itself and the rear sight screw. A takedown pin that has been turned with an ill-fitting blade develops a burred slot, and that is the failure that turns a two-minute strip into a stuck gun.
steps.quote: We recommend you clean and lubricate your firearm at least every 200 rounds for optimal performance. At the same time check for any lose screws or pins. Tighten the screws and press pins back in as needed.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Care and Maintenance, printed p.28 (PDF p.15)

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Four parts on the mat and the GX4 is as far apart as Taurus lets an owner take it. The firing pin block, the striker, the extractor, the sear and the trigger bar all stay inside, and the interchangeable backstrap is a fitting change rather than a cleaning task.
steps.prose: The one procedure the book publishes past this point is the magazine strip, which is where Deep Clean goes. Everything else in the exploded view is a parts list for ordering, with no sequence attached to it.
steps.quote: No further disassembly is recommended unless done by a qualified gunsmith.
steps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Magazine Disassembly, printed p.26 (PDF p.14)

deepSteps.title: Punch the spring seat, floorplate forward
deepSteps.action: Press a punch into the magazine spring seat through the floorplate hole and hold it down, then slide the floor plate toward the FRONT of the magazine. Keep a thumb across the plate as it clears the body.
deepSteps.prose: The GX4's 11-round body is short and the spring inside it is wound tight to feed reliably out of a micro grip, so the seat leaves under real pressure. Front is the direction because the seat's dimple sits rearward in the plate's slot; driving the plate backwards simply locks it harder.
deepSteps.quote: 1. Use a punch to press in on magazine spring seat/clip as shown in figure 1. 2. Slide the magazine floor plate toward the front of the magazine as shown in figure 2.
deepSteps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Magazine Disassembly, printed p.26 (PDF p.14)
deepSteps.warn: Take care to prevent the forcible ejection of the magazine spring plate and compressed magazine spring, and wear the ANSI Z87.1+ eye protection Taurus specifies.

deepSteps.title: Spring plate, spring and follower out - then leave it dry
deepSteps.action: Withdraw the magazine spring plate and the spring from the body, turn the magazine upside down and remove the follower. Brush the body out dry and wipe the follower; put no oil inside.
deepSteps.prose: Mark or remember which way the follower and the spring's closed end faced. A GX4 follower fits inverted and will still feed most of the magazine before failing on the top or bottom round, which is the kind of intermittent fault nobody traces back to a cleaning session.
deepSteps.caution: Taurus stops the owner at the magazine. Nothing in the GX4's fire control - striker, block, sear, trigger bar - is published as owner-serviceable.
deepSteps.quote:
Withdraw magazine spring plate and magazine spring
from magazine body. Turn magazine upside down and remove magazine follower.
deepSteps.cite:
TAURUS
GX4
INSTRUCTION MANUAL — Rev. 1 — Magazine Disassembly, printed p.26 (PDF p.14)

cleaning.name: BORE, CHAMBER & FEED RAMP
tasks: Remove excessive firing residue from the bore and chamber with a properly fitted brass brush dipped in gun cleaning solvent, then a dry cotton patch through the bore
Work from the chamber end - the barrel is out, so the crown never sees a rod
Scrub the feed ramp and the chamber hood; a 3-inch 9mm barrel runs hot and cokes fast
Use cloth, not steel, on the barrel's outside - the DLC finish is hard but it is still a coating
Look through the bore against a light before it goes back in the slide

cleaning.name: SLIDE, BREECH FACE & EXTRACTOR
tasks: Clean the exterior of the firearm, slide and rails with a non-abrasive cleaning cloth, and remove dust and residue from small crevices with a small brush
Pick the carbon out from under the extractor claw and off the breech face
Wipe the inside of the slide where the barrel lugs cam
On a T.O.R.O., wipe around the slide cover or the mounted optic and leave its screws untouched

cleaning.name: FRAME, TAKEDOWN PIN & MAGAZINES
tasks: Lubricate the frame rails and barrel lockup points - a film, not a bead
Clean the takedown pin's slot and check it is not burred; a chewed slot is what makes the next strip fail
Brush the magazine well dry and check the ejector is clean and straight
After cleaning, rub the pistol with a lightly oiled cloth
A pistol with a laser must not be cleaned in a well or supersonic machine that submerges it

reassembly: Place the barrel in the slide and push it to the rearward position.
Insert the recoil spring assembly into the slide over the barrel, compressing the spring slightly to get it into position.

Mount the slide on the frame, pull it fully to the rear and engage the slide catch; with a flat head screwdriver rotate the takedown pin clockwise a quarter turn until the slot is positioned vertically, then release the slide by pulling down on the slide catch.
With the magazine removed, cycle the slide several times to confirm barrel, slide and frame fit together properly.
fncheck: With the pistol confirmed empty: the takedown pin's slot must finish VERTICAL - that is the locked position and the single most important check on this gun; the slide should run its full stroke and return fully into battery; the slide catch should hold on an empty magazine and release cleanly; the trigger should reset audibly as the slide returns; and the visual loaded chamber indicator should sit flush on an empty chamber. The GX4 has no manual safety, so there is nothing external to test - carry it in the condition Taurus recommends for their pistols, a full magazine and an empty chamber, unless circumstances say otherwise.
